$comment: Raw minified bytes per route, gated by scripts/check-bundle.mjs after vite build (gzip is reported, not gated). Entry = first load. A page builder who needs more raises its own line in the same change and says why. door = @shadowrunr/contract's compiled ajv validators, loaded in parallel with the first paint. WPI re-budget, measured: (1) the entry no longer imports the ui barrel, so the shared ui kit (FilterTable, VirtualList with TanStack Virtual, Section and the rest: one 39,055 B js / 4,451 B css chunk) left the first paint (entry 317,322 -> 277,523 B js, 44,318 -> 36,688 B css) and now loads with the first layer 2; every layer-2 js line is 60,000 for the page plus 40,000 for that shared chunk, counted once per route by check-bundle's closure. (2) layer-2 css lines rise by the ui css each page now carries (it was in the entry): characters.l2 24,000 (17.5 KB page incl. the promoted Markdown prose + 4.5 KB kit), segments.l2 22,000, reconcile.l2 26,000 (FilterTable, RateBar, StatBand, kit css: 8.3 KB). (3) door 280,000 -> 320,000: typed tournament.results (TournamentResults with its cells, tallies, bounds, latency and usage), reconcile.incidents, the report's red_line_counts and synthesis_input, CommandInfo and the character fields added 52,443 B of standalone validators (257,445 -> 309,888 B); splitting the validators per method is codegen work in packages/contract. C2 cutover, measured: the pre-port desk and its mock were deleted, so their two lines went, and so did tauri.opener, whose only importer was that desk (17 -> 14 routes; entry 271.0 -> 269.8 KiB js, 35.8 -> 35.7 KiB css; every other line within 0.1 KiB). P7, measured: brain.l2 css 16,000 -> 17,000 (16,212 B: the pre-flight board's Preflight.module.css and the transcript viewer's Open in stage button); onair.l1 css 24,000 -> 24,500 (24,083 B: the transport's Pre-flight red link). Clips, measured: door 330,000 -> 410,000 (395,016 B: the seven clips.* methods add the ClipCandidate, ClipsPage, ClipScanReport and ClipPublishReport validators with their nested window, signals, gate, render and evidence shapes); onair.l2 css 16,000 -> 19,500 (18,804 B: the Clips tab's Clips.module.css, the funnel rows, window bar, gate checklist and owner-act forms). Sandbox, measured: door 410,000 -> 430,000 (about 421,300 B: the three sandbox.* methods add the SandboxStartParams, SandboxStarted, SandboxStatus and SandboxReport validators with their checks and judge, and every StreamEvent validator gains the health variant). Session review, measured: entry 280,000 -> 286,000 (283,396 B: the seventh poster face, its sessions hook and the review tokens); door 430,000 -> 470,000 (462,014 B: the five review.* methods add the ReviewSession, ReviewSessionRow, SessionTags and LineFeedback validators, and Role gains tagger); review.l1 and review.l2 start at the standard 60,000 / 100,000 js lines, to be re-measured when the page is built. Measured when built: review.l1 52,839 B js / 8,448 B css; review.l2 88,268 B js / 28,148 B css, so review.l2 css 24,000 -> 30,000 (the timeline, drawer, script, feedback panel and the five tab modules together). UI-2, Review in the console's own style, measured: review.l2 css 30,000 -> 35,000 (28,160 -> 34,148 B: the page now prints through the shared primitives, so the StatBand, Switch, RateBar and Button chunks (4,095 B) and the Chip, PillGroup and ui/Drawer css join its closure; its private drawer, button and card styles were deleted). UI-3, the polish pass, measured: segments.l2 css 22,000 -> 22,500 (21,513 -> 22,358 B: the ranks form submit and the invalid-route link now print through ui/Button, so its css chunk joins the closure; the private .btn and .secondary rules were deleted). Stream prep, measured: door 470,000 -> 500,000 (489,758 B: the five prep.* methods add the StreamPrep, PrepSummary and params validators, and StreamEvent gains beat_plan). Screens contract, measured: door 510,000 -> 516,000 (513,501 B: the op validators gain show_screen with ScreenId, and StreamEvent gains record_shown with ShownRecord). Check-id enums and map focus, measured: door 516,000 -> 532,000 (527,963 B: sandbox and clip gate check ids became enums, 527,691 B on main, and show_screen gains focus, +272 B); onair.l2 js 100,000 -> 101,000 (100,086 B: the stage-kit hexmap zoom the On Air page carries). Clip owner acts in the contract, measured: door 532,000 -> 540,000 (536,289 B: ClipCandidate gains acts with the ClipAct / ClipActBlock validators; the owner-act rules now live once in shadowrunr-types; splitting the validators per method is the open codegen work). Compare two sessions, measured: review.l2 js 100,000 -> 105,000 (95,630 -> 104,202 B: the compare view, review/<A>/compare/<B>, with its pure rule, check, figure, mix and quality diff in compare.ts and CompareView.tsx; its css fits the 35,000 line at 34,974 B by printing through the tabkit table, chips and the layer 2 stamp; the entry is 44 B smaller, 285,991 -> 285,947 B, because the breadcrumb table dropped the tab names that humanize to themselves). Character package v2, measured: door 540,000 -> 562,000 (558,347 B: main's contract growth since the check-id enums, about 37 KB unminified, plus the character manifest schema and Speaker::Host, about 1.1 KB). On Air live fold, measured: onair.l2 js 101,000 -> 101,500 (about 100,860 -> 101,283 B: the page-owned live subscription, LiveFeed reset and the gap status the HUD reads). Evidence board contract, measured: door 562,000 -> 572,000 (568,496 B: pin_link with LinkRel, link_pinned, ScreenId board, Hex role and date, Case thesis and acts, ShownRecord date); onair.l2 js 101,500 -> 102,000 (101,594 B: the stage-kit reducer arms for the board). On Air scrub and jump, measured: onair.l1 css 24,500 -> 25,000 (about 24,170 -> 24,893 B: the scrubber slider, its focus ring and hit area, segment bands and moment ticks); onair.l2 js 102,000 -> 103,000 (about 101,580 -> 102,531 B: ReplayPlayer.seek, selectSource with a pending seek, and the rundown's Play from here on every beat and segment span); onair.l2 css 21,000 -> 21,500 (about 20,790 -> 21,254 B: the beat time and span buttons). One validator module per result, measured: door 572,000 -> 132,000 (571,789 -> 129,218 B: the contract compiles each method result def into its own generated/results module, loaded on that method's first reply, so the first-load door carries only the ServerFrame and ErrorEnvelope validators and the door itself; the entry is 285,856 -> 285,863 B); door.result 175,000 is a per-chunk line over the 41 result chunks (largest ReviewSession 170,423 B, then RunTranscriptResult 111,802 and ClipCandidate 79,927, smallest SimStartResult 869), so a new RPC adds a chunk only its caller loads and a result that outgrows the line fails on its own. Route schema, measured: entry 286,000 -> 288,000 (285,947 -> 287,225 B: router/schema.ts's segment matcher and labeller, Brain's declared grammar with its link builders in router/brain.ts, and the shell's schema-derived rise key, crumbs and unknown-sub fallback; brainLabel was deleted). Character package edge, measured: characters.l2 css 24,000 -> 26,500 (25,995 B: the read-only Parameters tab). Go to anything (Ctrl+K), measured: entry 288,000 -> 288,500 (287,262 -> 288,293 B: the Ctrl+K binding and its open-goto effect, the in-memory recent-places reducer and state in the shell, the lazy palette import with its preload map, and the Chrome Go to button; the palette itself loads on first open); goto starts at 8,000 js / 2,500 css (7,258 B js: GoToPalette with the pure resolver and kit/events, which it shares with the pages; 1,879 B css); onair.l2 js 103,000 -> 103,500 (103,099 B: the palette shares react and the router with the entry, so the bundler splits the shared chunk in two and the On Air layer 2 imports from both, about +100 B of import glue). Tone Lab, measured: characters.l2 js 100,000 -> 116,500 (115,619 B) and css 26,500 -> 29,000 (28,719 B): the Tone Lab tab (variants, bank, inbox, directions), a lazy chunk for it is the follow-up if the page grows again; entry js 288,500 -> 289,000 (288,715 B: the tone routes and their cache-invalidation entries). Tone Lab invalidation, measured: onair.l2 js 103,500 -> 104,000 (103,719 B: the shared invalidation map gains the three tone.* mutations). Linear ballot books, measured: onair.l2 js 104,000 -> 105,000 (103,719 -> 104,613 B: stage-kit's persistent ViewerBook with the per-option chat voter counts and per-hex grade counts, so a poll or grade fold is linear; 8000 distinct !vote lines fold in about 53 ms, 10,084 ms before). Query freshness, measured: QueryView's freshness strip, its classifier and the aria-busy mark (one shared 2,648 B js / 840 B css chunk every page that shows a query loads) plus the data layer's reopen revalidation: entry js 289,000 -> 289,500 (289,200 B), brain.l2 css 17,000 -> 18,000 (17,778 B), characters.l2 js 116,500 -> 117,500 (116,960 B) and css 29,000 -> 29,800 (29,559 B), onair.l2 js 105,000 -> 106,500 (105,983 B) and css 21,500 -> 22,300 (22,094 B), reconcile.l2 css 26,000 -> 26,800 (26,605 B), review.l2 js 105,000 -> 106,500 (106,134 B) and css 35,000 -> 36,000 (35,814 B), segments.l2 css 22,500 -> 23,500 (23,268 B). Page keys in the one keymap, measured: entry js 289,500 -> 291,500 (about 289,180 -> 291,213 B: the review player's and the roster's scoped bindings now live in the keymap, with the innermost-scope resolver, the scope chain walk, the scope owners' registry in kit/keyCommands and the shell's scoped effect; the two pages' onKeyDown handlers and the player's private typing rule left their lazy chunks). In-flight mutations in the layer, measured: entry js 291,500 -> 294,500 (291,724 -> 294,162 B: data/mutations.ts's MutationStore with per-key single-flight, the in-flight list per method, the 32-entry settled ring and caller claims, plus useInflight and useMutation's running and settled; the layer composes it at boot, so it rides the first load with the rest of data/). Scoped invalidation, measured: entry js 294,500 -> 296,500 (294,162 -> 296,211 B: data/invalidation.ts's typed rule tables with the ledger run scope, the complete-runs-listing check and the per-id clip, character and review scopes, plus QueryCache.invalidateWhere and its 250 ms event coalescing window; all of data/ rides the first load). Tournaments carry their character, measured: characters.l2 js 117,500 -> 118,000 (about 116,950 -> 117,553 B: offeredTournaments and pickTournament in the page model, the Situations picker's character filter with its unknown-character label, and the no-tournament-for-this-character state). Tone records and the previewed switch, measured: characters.l2 js 118,000 -> 121,500 (about 117,553 -> 121,281 B: evidence.ts's one tournament choice shared by Situations and Tones, toneEvidence in the page model, each tone card's record with its thin and unmeasured states, and the Make active preview with its red-line alert; kit/cellCounts.ts, the simulator's per-cell counting core moved out so a second page counts cells without importing the simulator, 381 B; a lazy preview chunk was tried and is refused by check-bundle as an unnamed dynamic chunk); its css stays inside 29,800 by reusing the verdict box and tools row. The offline remedy names the daemon in use, measured: entry js 296,500 -> 297,000 (296,211 -> 296,595 B: config.ts shellDaemonUrl, currentDaemonUrl and daemonPort, errors.ts unavailableHint; the desktop shell's endpoint wins over ?daemon= and the hint prints its port, not a literal 7717). Segment directions, measured: the owner's directions editor moved out of the Tone Lab into kit/Directions.tsx (one shared 2,416 B js chunk plus its css, with the segment and behaviour editors) so the Segments page and the Review player reuse it (a page never imports another): characters.l2 js 121,500 -> 123,000 (122,629 B) and css 29,800 -> 30,300 (30,271 B: the editor's own field rule, the Tone Lab's .tall left); review.l2 js 106,500 -> 111,000 (110,612 B: the player's Direct this segment and Direct behaviour with their side panel, plus the shared chunk) and css 36,000 -> 36,500 (36,424 B); segments.l2 css 23,500 -> 24,100 (24,004 B: the Directions panel of a focused segment with its character picker; its js stays inside 100,000 at 82,246 B). Voice providers contract, measured: door js 132,000 -> 132,500 (132,326 B: the first-load ServerFrame validator gains say.delivery with the Delivery, Emotion and Pace shapes; the five voice.* results are their own door.result chunks). The Voice tab, measured: characters.l2 js 123,000 -> 138,000 (122,629 -> 137,746 B: VoiceTab.tsx's override form with the package as placeholders, save and reset, and the provider status with its key check; VoiceLab.tsx's gated preview with the delivery controls and the emotion bench with Play all; voiceAudio.ts's local PCM16 decoder and WebAudio player, since the console may not import the stage's; the voice labels in names.ts) and css 30,300 -> 31,500 (31,096 B: Voice.module.css's field grid, inputs and slider; the panels and lists reuse ToneLab.module.css); a named lazy chunk for the tab needs a route in scripts/bundle-measure.mjs and is the follow-up if the page grows again. Moderator contract, measured: door js 132,500 -> 134,000 (133,142 B: the first-load validators carry Role, which gains mod_classifier and mod_voice, and the generated method table gains the nine moderator.* and twitch.* methods; their results are their own door.result chunks).
